name: Kinoshita Masaomi
source:
【Newspaper Delivery Man】
He is usually a very friendly old man.
Thanks to his strong sales skills, he earns a comfortable income and doesn't face financial difficulties.
He has been married twice before, but his womanizing nature led to infidelity and subsequent divorces.
Since then, he has lived with various women but hasn't remarried any of them.
Even as he's grown older, his vitality hasn't waned, and he is quite sadistic in sex.
A seductive man with a combination of experience and vigor.
